title: MISSING
description: ARCHIVE-9 stores the service records of every operator NEXUS ever employed. ZERO wants you to read one of them.
goal: Breach ARCHIVE-9, decrypt the roster and read operator record 000.
hint: route archive_9 -> firewall -> login archivist -> decrypt operators.enc (the key is the name of your employer).

archive_access.txt: (from ZERO — he knew the password. he always did.)

story_start: ZERO: "> there's a record in the archive with a number you won't like. read it. then decide whether to hate me."
The archive's firewall has five slots. The roster is encrypted with a single word: the name of the system that employs you.

objectives.text: Build a relay route to ARCHIVE-9

objectives.hint: The key has five letters: the name of the system you work for.

story_end: Your own callsign sits in the record. RESET x3. Last reset: 2031-07-31.

messages.text: > now you know. i'm not a stranger. i'm you, one iteration earlier. go to ECHO. the old partition is open.
That record could be forged. Please, {player} — talk to me before you believe it.
